text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kashiwa Kinen.
Hokko Tarumae won it last year, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the paddock—last year's victor was nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae... If possible, I wanted to run
with you here. But—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm still far from fully recovered...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ever since returning from Dubai, she seems to manage daily life okay, but racing is still...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, didn't Tarumae-chan say
her tummy was hurting a bit?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just fatigue from traveling abroad,
looks like I had a stomach bug? too, you see~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I see... Feng shui was showing signs
of a minor illness, but..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"You must be feeling down, Tarumae.
I hope that soon..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Cheer up now, Ricky-chan.
Tarumae-chan won't be happy
seeing you with such a gloomy face, you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And of course, for all the fans
who are looking forward to a great race, too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry. It might be concerning for now,
but in the loooong run..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Someday, it'll turn into a fond memory. That's just how the world works, y'know."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In the long run...
...You're right, aren't you, Ms. Acute?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's gonna be happy if I just mope around here today!
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae isn't the only strong rival.
That's right, Acute-san is here too!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mmhmm. After all, the number of races she's run in is on a whole different level.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hustle and bustle today~!
Can't be letting Rickey-chan get all lonely, now can I?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll definitely put on a great run too☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Although Hokko Tarumae isn't here today, Wonder Acute looks to be the biggest rival.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to lose—for my own sake, and for
Tarumae's sake. And there's one more reason—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yes, because today is—!
